_note: CUST-HV V9d-4 — commerce firewall (V0 §14.3). A hostile document: every scope the production normalizer accepts (document tokens, branding, header, footer, contact, whatsapp, social, verification, sbc, apps, navigation, pagePresentation, announcements, palette, homepage sections, section content, section design, design.cards, nested items) carries commercial keys (price, discount, stock, availability, tax, total, currency, sku, quantity, shipping fee / amount, freight, delivery fee, offer status, coupon code, cost). After normalisation NO such key may survive anywhere, and no injected value may be reachable. Shared by PHP StorefrontPresentationNormalizer and both TS twins (normalizePresentationConfig). Deny rule (shared by the PHP and both TS suites): split a key into words (camelCase / snake_case / kebab-case, lower-cased); the key is DENIED when any word is in `commerceWords` and the LAST word is not in `presentationSuffixes`. So value-bearing and scaling / hiding controls (price, unitPrice, taxAmount, priceMultiplier, discountScale, hideStock, availabilityVisible, showPrice, offerStatus…) are denied, while position / colour-role / size-step / shape / placement controls over real data (pricePosition, stockTextSize, availabilityBadgePlacement…) and the id selectors (offerIds, productIds) are allowed. `allowedKeys` must never be denied; `deniedKeys` must always be. Exempt (suffix) keys are checked by VALUE as well: a key that contains a commerce word must never carry a number after normalisation (priceSize: 0, stockTextSize: 0, pricePosition: 5 are injected; presentation controls are bounded string enums), which is the schema assertion V0 §14.3 asks for. Only the approved selector keys (`selectorKeys`: productIds, offerIds) are exempt by name as id lists; any other `…Ids` key (priceIds, stockIds) is denied, and a commerce-named key must not carry a number or a list containing one. A commerce-named key is also denied when it contains a hiding / scaling verb (`hidingVerbs`: hidePricePosition, hideStockPlacement), whatever its suffix, and a commerce-named key must not carry a number, a boolean or a list containing one (controls are bounded string enums). Non-numeric commerce CONTENT is denied too (V0 §14.3: no product names / images stored in presentation JSON, no invented badges, no generated urgency copy): a key whose words include every word of any `forbiddenWordSets` entry is denied (productName, productImage, badgeText, saleBadge, countdownCopy, urgencyText…), and the injected strings (`Last 3!`, `SALE NOW`) must not be reachable in the normalised document. The word-set rule honours presentation suffixes too: badgeTextColor / saleBadgePosition (colour role / position of a REAL badge) are allowed, badgeText / hideBadgeText are denied.
